name: coop-save-load-guards
description: Co-op-only early refusal of checkpoint books and audited HP frontend save/load entries; original single-player bodies remain.
source_snapshot: current .local/game read-only snapshot; root must merge this edge into the build hash chain
scope: SavePoint Touch/OnSaveGame return before health, visibility, timer, destruction or native queue changes.
HPConsole selected-slot save/load and doLevelSave return before SloMo, pause and metadata writes.
FEBook save/load page routes return before UI opening/pause and saved-game URLs before queued travel.
SP and Versus paths pass through the original function bodies unchanged.
known_gaps: Not a native engine Exec sandbox. Direct native console/frontend commands require their own verified integration.
Non-Ch1 CutScript LOADSAVE/SAVENUM/LOADNUM and SleepingGoyle reload calls are outside this narrow recipe.
Does not implement checkpoints, map rollback, save serialization or load recovery.
